notes.title: Magical Girl Clicker!!
notes.notes:
[b]■Magical Girl Clicker arrival!■
[/b]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41371388/f0a63d1deed4e81a7557dbf26dd03407544656a5.png[/img]

Click & idling!
Gather the hearts of cute girls and see their naughty appearance!

Click on the cute Magical Girl to activate "Fever Mode", boosting your clicking power!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41371388/2eb99250f59b071fbd00d94703dca7b4d5e9f6d1.png[/img]

Use the hearts you accumulate by clicking to upgrade your items! Grow to get more hearts!
Achievements make Click useful!
Repeat click and fever mode to produce more hearts!

Appeal point
・A cute wizard animation has been added to the traditional clicker game style.
  Purchasing upgrades dramatically increases heart production
・Chance to get a lot of hearts in "Fever Mode"!
・Let's get "Ultra Fever Mode" where you can get more hearts!
・Equipped with a convenient system such as purchasing as much as you can, boosting productivity with selected animations, etc.

You can enjoy the traditional clicker game style and the cuteness of anime-style magical girls.

[b]■Store Page■[/b]

notes.title: System Update!
notes.notes:
Hi! Gamers!
Updated the game right away.

1: System can be set.
Now you can set the volume and buttons!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35375532/0b1b279219ebd09bb6441d60aedba139e16720e3.png[/img]

2: Released the Japanese version.
The Japanese version was released because the technical problem was solved.
I think it's possible to use the language of your steam, so English users can play in English and Japanese users can play in Japanese.
See Steam help for language switching!

https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=8487-WSCN-4121&l=english
